$schema: Maintained by Plickify. Newest entries first. Fork users see this file's contents on the /updates page and via the nav bell.

updates.title: Vector files (SVG/AI/EPS) + smarter, honest metadata
changes: Upload SVG, AI, EPS and PDF files - rasterized locally in your browser (better than CSV Tree: no proxy needed)
Vector-aware AI prompting: flat-design vocabulary instead of invented camera/photography terms
New accuracy contract: the model must describe only visible elements and return fewer honest keywords rather than unrelated padding
Sharper vector rendering with white backdrop and up to 3x upscale
Redesigned result cards with status pills and a placeholder tile for vector files

updates.title: Generator option fixes + update notifications
changes: Mode switch now applies per image already queued (no more mixed metadata/prompt results)
PNG detection fixed: transparent-background phrasing works even after client-side compression
Version sorting is numeric - 1.10.x will order correctly above 1.9.x
Nav bell + /updates changelog now reliably show every new release

updates.title: Community feed ships from the official repo only
changes: /community content moved from database to community.json in the repository
updates.action: If you ran migration 0011_social_posts.sql earlier, you may delete the social_posts table - it is no longer used.

updates.title: Marketing banner + Community feed
changes: announcement.json: developer-controlled dismissible banner, auto-synced to all forks
New /community feed page plus a Community nav link

updates.title: In-site update notification system
changes: Nav bell shows a pulsing badge whenever a new release arrives
New /updates changelog page: per-version changes, bug fixes, SQL migration lists and action guides
updates.json ships with the code so forked sites see the same timeline after auto-sync

updates.title: Auto-sync workflow for forks
changes: Hourly GitHub Action now merges official releases into every fork automatically
Vercel redeploys forks by itself after each sync - zero manual work
Conflicts (only when core files were customized) fail loudly with clear guidance

updates.title: Developer popup placement
changes: Developer popup now opens as a compact dropdown directly beneath the </> nav icon (CSV Tree behaviour) instead of a centered modal
bugfixes: Outside click and Escape close the popup reliably

updates.title: Fork-ready release + README rewrite
changes: Home platform strip is generated from the export platform list
README completely rewritten: A-Z fork guide covering all 10 migrations, BYOK tutorials, custom domain notes and troubleshooting

updates.title: Nav cleanup & health widget accuracy
changes: Removed the About page and the Generator/About nav links
Header brand always shows the site name next to the logo
bugfixes: Health widget AI status now counts personal browser keys as connected, not just the server env key

updates.title: Subtle developer credit with real logo
changes: Nav shows a small developer icon instead of a highlighted button
Footer row: footer text left, copyright centered, Made-by logo right
Official Plickify Academy logo bundled

updates.title: Header utilities + protected attribution
changes: New header widgets beside the profile: dark/light toggle reflecting current state, Web Health popover (website/database/AI/version) and Developer menu
Footer carries the required Made by Plickify credit
updates.action: No action needed. Note: the Plickify attribution is license-protected - removing it stops the site from rendering and blocks generation.

updates.title: Generator layout: docked left sidebar
changes: Controls panel is now a full-height panel pinned to the left edge with its own scroll
Metadata cards use the entire remaining viewport width

updates.title: Custom domain login guide
changes: Troubleshooting steps for login after adding a custom domain (Supabase URL allowlist)
updates.action: If your custom domain login loops: Supabase > Authentication > URL Configuration must include https://yourdomain.com/** and be set as Site URL.

updates.title: AI Providers selection + bilingual key tutorials
changes: New Admin > AI Providers page: choose which providers users can add keys for
API Keys modal shows step-by-step tutorials in English and Bangla for every provider
Disabled providers are hidden and rejected by the generation API
updates.action: RUN MIGRATION: open Supabase SQL Editor and run supabase/migrations/0010_enabled_providers.sql. Without it, saving provider selection fails.

updates.title: Editable page content + admin UI refresh
changes: New Admin > Page Content: edit hero, feature cards, how-it-works steps and About text without code
Modern admin sidebar with grouped sections and active highlighting
Redesigned home page with gradient hero and dynamic platform strip
updates.action: RUN MIGRATION: run supabase/migrations/0009_page_content.sql in Supabase SQL Editor. Until you do, the Page Content page will show save errors.

updates.title: Professional generator UI
changes: Left controls sidebar is pinned while cards scroll
Success popup after every finished batch with correct downloads (metadata = CSV, prompts = CSV + TXT)
Auto-fallback toasts show which provider failed and which took over

updates.title: Batch limit raised for existing installs
changes: Existing databases move from the old 10-image cap to 200
bugfixes: Clearer 'batch limit reached' message pointing to the setting
updates.action: OPTIONAL: run 0008_raise_batch_limit.sql, or just set Max Images / Batch manually in Admin > Generator Settings.

updates.title: Unlimited generation
changes: Rate limit 0 means unlimited generations per hour
Batch size can go up to 200 images
updates.action: RUN MIGRATION: run supabase/migrations/0007_unlimited_generation.sql, otherwise saving Rate Limit = 0 fails with a constraint error.

updates.title: Custom favicon override
changes: Removed the scaffold favicon that always overrode the uploaded one
Icon metadata emits icon + shortcut + apple-touch-icon links

updates.title: Exact CSV Tree export formats restored
changes: Platform templates are byte-identical to CSV Tree (Adobe Stock without description, Shutterstock without title, Magnific semicolon format)

updates.title: Admin Panel changes apply instantly
changes: All pages render dynamically so branding/theme/site-name edits appear immediately
bugfixes: Settings saves now upsert - rows auto-create even if migrations were partially run
Branding uploads force the storage bucket public so logos render

updates.title: CSV Tree generator parity + admin-only site
changes: Metadata and Image-to-Prompt modes with every control from CSV Tree
13-provider API key rotation with cross-provider fallback
Whole site gated behind Google login; only active admins enter

updates.title: Initial public release
changes: AI metadata generator with bulk queue, CSV exports and admin panel
Supabase auth + database migrations with RLS
updates.action: Fresh installs must run migrations 0001-0006 in order.
